issues.quote:
(2) This section does not apply to:

(i) Retail facilities;

(ii) Oil or gas well drilling or servicing operations; or,

(iii) Normally unoccupied remote facilities.
issues.rationale: Paragraph (a)(2) establishes an explicit absence of application and is already captured as a standalone exemption in C0004 with not_required modality and no target link required.

These exceptions qualify the flammable process application rule in (a)(1)(ii); their specific baseline is not registered as an independent non-modifier rule alias in the draft inventory, so discrete qualification targeting remains unresolved outside the grouped condition.
